subject: Charged twice for my order
body: I was charged twice for order 5521 and the money has left my account. Please fix this as soon as possible.

subject: Mon colis est en retard
body: Bonjour, mon colis devait arriver mardi et je ne l'ai toujours pas reçu. Le suivi indique encore en transit.
reason: Package is late and the tracking still shows in transit.

subject: I cannot log in
body: I cannot log in to my account. It says my account is locked after too many attempts. I need access to place an order today.
reason: Customer is locked out of the account and needs access today.

subject: Question sur ma facture

subject: Package never arrived
body: My package was shipped on October 20 and it still has not arrived after more than three weeks. The tracking page has not changed.

subject: Mon appareil ne fonctionne pas

subject: Very poor service
body: I am unhappy with the service I received. I waited 40 minutes on the phone and nobody was able to help me.

subject: Compte bloqué

subject: Item arrived broken

subject: Livraison le dimanche?

subject: Business hours question

subject: Invoice question

subject: Wrong address on my order

subject: Débité deux fois

subject: Nice website

subject: Package delayed
